notes.title: Update v. 1.0068
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with displaying information on order forms;
[*] Fixed a bug where the backpack might not open after dialogue with Eyeperator;
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented order forms from being closed.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] In house №2, you may now encounter obstacles set up by disgruntled residents who do not want to order eyeballs.
[/list]

Work on improvements and changes based on your feedback and suggestions continues but may proceed more slowly due to the developer's necessary external commitments.

notes.title: Update v. 1.0066

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug that caused the flashlight to not turn on after using a battery.

tags.balance_change: [*] Changed the balance - the difficulty has become slightly higher;

tags.feature: [*] Added text prompts for consumables when they are illuminated in the backpack;
[*] There is now a clock above some entryway doors;
[*] Changed the mechanics of intercoms - it is now required to press the bell button after entering the apartment to contact the client;
[*] Additional audible alarms have been added for intercoms;

tags.bug: [*] No more tripping over the curb. The local government utilized the budget and repaved the curb, replacing it with a smoother curb. Externally it is the same curb, but the budget has been utilized.

notes.title: Update v. 1.0065
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that disabled the ability to view order forms.
[*] Fixed a bug that turned NPC text into gibberish. Yes, literally gibberish.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the color of information on order forms to be brighter and more readable.
[*] Increased the text size in the field displaying apartment numbers to prevent confusion between the numbers 6 and 8.
[*] Jars with eyeballs now have a unique identifier displayed in the top-left corner of the corresponding order form.
[/list]
